styles.name: lorenz
styles.description: Lorenz butterfly attractor (σ=10 ρ=28 β=8/3) seen in the x–z plane: the orbit loops round both wings as progress lengthens it, and the view swings about the z axis with time

styles.name: rossler
styles.description: Rössler attractor (a=b=0.2, c=5.7) seen from above and a little to the side: the orbit winds outward round a tilted spiral band, then lifts into the fold-over lobe and drops back to the centre; progress lengthens the orbit, time turns the view

styles.name: clifford
styles.description: Three Clifford attractors (x′=sin ay+c·cos ax, y′=sin bx+d·cos by) from classic parameter sets, each densifying from a sprinkle into its swirling filaments as progress reaches it; parameters breathe with time

styles.name: de-jong
styles.description: Three Peter de Jong attractors (x′=sin ay−cos bx, y′=sin cx−cos dy) from classic parameter sets, densifying into their folded ribbons one after another with progress; parameters breathe with time

styles.name: henon
styles.description: Hénon map (a=1.4, b=0.3): the boomerang-shaped strange attractor with its parallel folded bands, densifying from scattered points as progress iterates it; a breathes with time

styles.name: logistic-bifurcation
styles.description: Logistic-map bifurcation diagram: r runs 2.8→4.0 left to right, the long-run values of x stacked up each column — one branch forks into 2, 4, 8 and dissolves into chaos, with the period-3 window near r≈3.83; progress sweeps r, time stirs the chaos

styles.name: double-pendulum
styles.description: A real double pendulum (two rods, two bobs) swinging chaotically from a pivot that rides along the top rail with progress, the lower bob trailing its recent path

styles.name: standard-map
styles.description: Chirikov–Taylor standard map phase portrait (θ across, p up): a fan of orbits traces wavy KAM curves and island chains, and as progress raises K from 0.3 to 1.4 the curves break up into a chaotic sea; the portrait scrolls in θ with time

styles.name: gingerbreadman
styles.description: Gingerbreadman map (x′=1−y+|x|, y′=x) from (−0.1, 0): the orbit fills the chunky hexagonal gingerbread-man silhouette, densifying as progress iterates it

styles.name: duffing
styles.description: Duffing oscillator phase portrait (ẏ=−δy+αx−βx³+γcos ωt): the forced orbit loops round both potential wells, its trace lengthening with progress

styles.name: tinkerbell
styles.description: The Tinkerbell attractor (x′=x²−y²+ax+by, y′=2xy+cx+dy; a=0.9 b=−0.6013 c=2 d=0.5): its looping wand-trail shape densifies as it travels along the bar with progress
